power.interpretation: Conditional sensitivity simulation from only five DSC seeds, independently resampled model groups +0.005 shift, whole seed rows then paired image bootstrap. Test-image extrapolation assumes exchangeability; null rejection calibration reported. Not post-hoc achieved power or guarantee.

grid_crossings.interpretation: Exploratory conditional grid crossing only. Empirical null rejection exceeds nominal5%; no calibrated80%-power sample-size recommendation is supported.

power.calibration_conclusion: The reported conditional simulations fail nominal5% null calibration. Increasing resampled images repeats a finite empirical test set and can amplify pseudo-replication. Raw80% crossings are reported for transparency, but reliable required seeds/images are not established; no new calibration method or scientific settings were introduced.
